summary: Request Emporia's most recently completed UTC hour rather than the open current hour, auto-discover current Emporia devices when a setup omits device_gid, and cover both behaviors with a deterministic clock seam and regression tests.
reason: Live acceptance showed that collection requested the current hourly bucket and then correctly discarded it as incomplete, which meant the Go collector could never persist Emporia readings. The deployed Python collector also discovers all current Emporia devices, whereas the Go collector sent an empty device identifier when device_gid was omitted.
validated_outcome: When device_gid is omitted, Emporia discovers and collects each current device; it requests the final second of the prior UTC hour from one injected clock, retains a completed returned hour, and still rejects a current partial hour. Focused and full Go tests, race tests, vet, build, format, and diff checks pass.
